tools.name: pabandi_list_businesses
tools.description: List active businesses for booking, with optional city, category, search, and cursor pagination.

tools.name: pabandi_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking and its escrow record. Requires authentication.

tools.name: pabandi_get_booking
tools.description: Get a booking with its escrow state.

tools.name: pabandi_mark_checkin
tools.description: Mark a booking as attended. A verified check-in moves escrow to conditions_met; an overridden check-in opens a dispute.

tools.name: pabandi_release_escrow
tools.description: Release a booking escrow to the business after verified completion. Requires business owner or admin.

tools.name: pabandi_refund_booking
tools.description: Refund a booking deposit under policy. Requires client, business owner, or admin.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a Pabandi trust disclosure or passport signature.

tools.name: pabandi_request_payout
tools.description: Request a USDC payout to a local rail, bank, or connected account. Requires authentication.

tools.name: pabandi_get_payout_history
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's payout history.

tools.name: pabandi_get_paid_proof
tools.description: Get a public payment proof by its public ID.

tools.name: pabandi_get_my_paid_proofs
tools.description: Get the authenticated worker's payment proofs.

tools.name: pabandi_get_identity
tools.description: Return the authenticated agent or user identity.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pabandi_verify_passport" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Verify a Pabandi PTP attestation (agent/business/individual/trust rail). Input base64-encoded attestation token and optional need (e.g. "act:book"). Returns valid, grantedCapabilities, riskBand, expiresAt. Works offline. Example: {"token": "...base64...", "need": "act:book"}" → after: "Verify a Pabandi trust disclosure or passport signature."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
